r: cmuwmtopbm - convert a CMU window manager bitmap into a PBM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

cmuwmtopbm reads a CMU window manager bitmap as input. and produces a PBM image as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for cmuwmtopbm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
